description: Hand cases for the props.vehicle.* rows and the vehicles pack's session (PL.native-vehicle-rows): what core's corpora conformance/props/vehicle-placement.json and conformance/traversal/vehicles-only.json leave unpinned — props.vehicle.contract whole (each constant's export name), a footprint and a street turned by their axis, a round building, a point street, a half-stated height band, a box whose half is not a point, a street with a slot and something E acts on, null lists and groundY read as absent, a negative and a short probe radius, the [invalid-input] boundary of what core cannot read, a session with runsTraversal false (no planner op, no block written, a carried block not read), and a session's load through core's loadVehicleLayers (no block, or a block with no vehicles, starts the registry again). Every expectation is computed by core's own functions and classes at the pin (gen-bridge-vehicle-cases.mts, kept with the builder's record); each case asserts the input it pins changes core's answer.

cases.name: props.vehicle.contract: every constant keyed as core's corpus contract keys it, the name core exports it under, the refusals, the tiers and the deviations

tiers.1: every rule: open ground, clear of the slots, and nothing E acts on in reach of the spot or of any of its eight stands
tiers.2: open ground clear of the slots; nothing E acts on in reach of the spot (its stands need only be open)
tiers.3: open ground with nothing E acts on in reach of the spot; a villager's slot may be nearer than 4 m

deviations.unreal: no tier finds a spot: the vehicle stands at the street by the place itself (StreetPointNear 8 m), or the place's point, logged "NO open spot" (VT:431–436)
deviations.core: refuses with `no-open-spot`, carrying that same spot as `at` (and `onStreet`)
deviations.why: the ruling's shape asks for a decision or a refusal with a code; an engine that still draws the vehicle draws it at `at`, as Unreal does

deviations.unreal: a street point is the navmesh point a probe projects to (60 x 60 x 80 cm box) that lies on a road band or paving (OnStreet; VD:1663–1688)
deviations.core: the caller states the street as areas (`streets`) or passes `isStreet`; the spot is the probe point itself
deviations.why: core has no navmesh; the probe pattern (rings 0.75 m apart, eight ways, odd rings turned half a step) is core's

deviations.unreal: a building's footprint is the world-aligned bounds of its colliding components, grown 60 cm on X and Y (VT:372–383)
deviations.core: the caller states each footprint as a box (`at`, `half`, `axis`) or a circle, grown 0.6 m along its own axes (a circle by its radius)
deviations.why: meshes and transforms are the engine's; for a box on the world axes the two agree

deviations.unreal: open ground is no WorldStatic overlap with a capsule of radius 40 cm and half-height 88 cm centred 100 cm up (VT:386–390)
deviations.core: no stated static within 0.4 m (strictly) of the spot whose height band meets 0.12–1.88 m above the ground; a static with no band always meets it
deviations.why: the capsule's rounded ends are the engine's shape; the statics are stated, not overlapped

deviations.unreal: the overlap is tested at each candidate's own navmesh height
deviations.core: the band is read at the place's ground (`groundY`) for every spot
deviations.why: core works on (x, z) with no terrain, as pickup-placement.ts does

deviations.unreal: AnyInteractableNear answers true everywhere while a props panel is open (VP:1132), so a load with a panel open finds no tier's spot
deviations.core: an open panel is not read: only where things stand
deviations.why: where a vehicle is parked does not depend on what the player has open
